summary.en: Sonoko must go to a wedding representing her family, and since she doesn't want to go alone, she ropes Conan and Ran into going with her. The groom Masaru is the eldest son and heir of the incredibly rich Hatakeyama family, and he's marrying a young woman named Miho. The wedding takes place in a very nice villa, and though things are going well at first. Until the end of the reception.

suspects: Yoshifumi Ito, Shiro Hatakeyama, Tatsuya Ishihara, Arisa Hatakeyama, and Rikako Ishihara
